title: Indigenous and Afro-descendant peoples: rebellion and resistance
goal: I can describe the position of indigenous and Afro-descendant people in the 18th century, including Túpac Amaru II and the runaway communities.
grammar: A pesar de: rebellion and resistance

items: I can say who Túpac Amaru II was and what happened in 1780 and 1781.
I can describe how indigenous people were treated under colonial law.
I can explain what palenques and quilombos were.
I can say why San Basilio de Palenque is well known today.
I can use a pesar de and a pesar de que to talk about something that happened despite a difficulty.
